headline: Core Platform covers the desktop application shell, configuration, shared application state, multi-language support and a fork-upstreaming task; of the five tickets, only multi-language support was confirmed in the code the analysis read.
what_is_there: The code clearly supports English, Vietnamese and Japanese, with a full translation table and the ability to switch language while the app is running and notify the screens to update. There are also signs that model routing and Co4E-related surfaces exist, though those were seen only in passing.
what_is_unclear: The analysis did not retrieve the files behind the desktop app shell (main window, navigation, top bar, system tray), the JSON configuration system with its version migration and environment overrides, or the shared application state and connection caching — so those could not be confirmed either way. The upstreaming task is a process-level item that code alone cannot settle.
suggested_action: Ask the team to point to where the app shell, configuration system and shared state live so a targeted second pass can confirm them, and get a verbal status on the upstreaming task since it is not something code can evidence.
